cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? Then we'll get to my list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you send it to me? I'll put that beside my invitation's timestamp before we open it.

confusable: D172 records a position before revision; D184 protects A's disclosure sequence around personal involvement.
comparison: A socially sensitive ex invitation differs from a large fireworks order.
seedUse: Keep same-message challenge and timestamps; use precise addressee/date corrections rather than generalized professionalism.
